items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-11-10
items.q: My father played with Pal Eddie's band

ctx.x: Do you remember the Beisdorfer band back in the period when you were coming out of the Navy?

I heard of it. I heard of it, yeah. I heard of it. I heard of it when I came. Is that the one that was at the Toque T out at Spanish Fort? It's at Spanish Fort, yeah. Yeah. I used to listen. My father played with Pal Eddie's band, which used to be the concert band out there.

And he used to take me out there in the afternoon. Well, that was at West End Park. No, no, no. At Spanish Fort? Spanish Fort, yeah. Spanish Fort. I didn't think Pal Eddie went to Spanish Fort. Yeah, he was at Spanish Fort.
